description: Regression matrix of operating systems for the Svavyom host (M4-E01-S03). 'expect' is what the product must do on that system: 'supported' means preflight passes and the full certification run is expected to pass; 'refused' means the installer must refuse and say why (the preflight verdict is the evidence). A row is only 'certified' by a signed certification record made on a real host of that system (certification/README.md). This file is a development and release tool; it is not part of any release artifact.

newer LTS: not qualified until a run says so
